answer: A forge is one fake identity. The hollow is a registry tied to one nonexportable host root that rented hosts cannot copy. A jetty is one attested epoch of host-issued random work. Each successive clone must complete one more jetty than the previous clone in a fresh chain bound to its own key and begun only after the prior host signature, so work cannot be precomputed, split, or parallelized. One thousand clones cost 500,500 jetty. If the host signs two chains from one state, the defence breaks.
